scripts.dev: pnpm db:init && concurrently --kill-others --names api,web,worker "node scripts/backend.mjs uvicorn sqoch_api.app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --reload --reload-dir backend/sqoch_api" "vite" "node scripts/backend.mjs python -m sqoch_api.notifications.worker"
scripts.lint:frontend: oxlint src scripts e2e vite.config.ts playwright.config.ts
scripts.format:check: oxfmt --check --ignore-path .gitignore --ignore-path .oxfmtignore . && uv run --project backend --locked ruff format --check backend
scripts.setup: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --pm-on-fail=ignore --dir tools/openapi install --frozen-lockfile && uv sync --project backend --locked
scripts.lint:backend: uv run --project backend --locked ruff check backend && uv run --project backend --locked mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml backend/sqoch_api backend/tests
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:binding && pnpm lint:frontend && pnpm lint:backend
scripts.test: pnpm test:frontend && pnpm test:backend && pnpm test:tooling
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm contracts:check && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm docs:check
